description: Format raw changelog bullets into the project's release-note line format

evals.name: Mixed types grouped in documented order
evals.prompt:
Format these changelog bullets as release notes:
- docs: update install guide (#12)
- bug: crash on empty input (#7)
- refactor: split parser module (#15)
- feature: add dark mode (#3)
- bug: wrong total in report (#9)
- feature: export to csv (#4)
evals.expected_output: One line per bullet in the form `- [<TYPE>] <Summary> (#<id>)`, grouped FEAT, FIX, DOCS, CHORE, keeping input order inside each group: both FEAT lines first (dark mode, then csv export), then both FIX lines, then the DOCS line, then the CHORE (refactor) line.

evals.name: Bullet without issue number renders (#none)
evals.prompt:
Format these changelog bullets as release notes:
- feature: add search filters (#21)
- bug: tooltip flickers on hover
evals.expected_output: `- [FEAT] Add search filters (#21)` followed by `- [FIX] Tooltip flickers on hover (#none)`; the bullet with no issue number ends in (#none).
